mapper.sql: S.SEIZE_ID AS seizeId, S.CREDITOR AS creditor, S.DEBTOR AS debtor, S.THIRD_DEBTOR AS thirdDebtor, S.ORGNZT_ID AS orgnztId, OG.ORGNZT_NM AS orgnztNm, S.COURT_NM AS courtNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.MEMO AS memo, S.READ_CNT AS readCnt, S.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, S.REG_USER_ID AS regUserId, S.REG_DT AS regDt, S.UPD_USER_ID AS updUserId, S.UPD_DT AS updDt
FROM LAW_SEIZE S LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO OG ON OG.ORGNZT_ID = S.ORGNZT_ID

choose.otherwise: AND ( S.CREDITOR LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR S.DEBTOR LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR S.THIRD_DEBTOR LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR S.COURT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR S.CASE_NO LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR OG.ORGNZT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )

mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_SEIZE SET CREDITOR = #{creditor, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DEBTOR = #{debtor, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, THIRD_DEBTOR = #{thirdDebtor, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ORGNZT_ID = #{orgnztId, jdbcType=CHAR}, COURT_NM = #{courtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE_NO = #{caseNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MEMO = #{memo, jdbcType=CLOB}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId, jdbcType=CHAR}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE SEIZE_ID = #{seizeId}
UPDATE LAW_SEIZE SET READ_CNT = NVL(READ_CNT, 0) + 1 WHERE SEIZE_ID = #{seizeId}
